assessment_type: source-bound owner analysis; no production code change and no fitted numerical tolerance

evidence_reconciliation.exact_linear: F-SI24/F-VQ30 establish the theorem-derived factor-2 construction and an infinity-norm bound for the qualified linear dissipative problem.
evidence_reconciliation.nonlinear_transfer: F-SI24 and F-VQ30 show no negative transfer against their persisted finite same-endpoint comparators, but the comparator is not truth and B_inf/comparator ratios are strongly state/horizon dependent.
evidence_reconciliation.nonlinear_conservatism: F-VQ30 B_inf/E1_512 spans approximately 6.685 to 102.498; this rules out reading B_inf as a calibrated approximation of true nonlinear error.
evidence_reconciliation.raw_observer_history: F-SI23 showed much larger state-dependent conservatism and no global multiplicative calibration.
evidence_reconciliation.retry_translation: F-VQ28 showed that a fixed-horizon conservative relation for an earlier raw head observable did not survive the actual retry topology; smaller dt cannot be assumed to improve any new certificate monotonically without direct qualification.
evidence_reconciliation.true_reference: F-VQ29 failed closed because the finite-refinement reference could not support a rigorous nonlinear error-bound qualification under frozen controls.
evidence_reconciliation.legacy_tolerance: F-SI20 theory/source evidence rejects CritDevH nonlinear convergence criteria and legacy iteration-count timestep adaptation as temporal-accuracy contracts.
evidence_reconciliation.generic_transaction_contract: F-KT09 requires only an explicit model-owned finite nonnegative dimensionless scalar <=1 and deliberately owns no Richards normalization or numerical limit.

requirements: H_budget is explicit, finite, positive and has units cm pressure head.
H_budget is supplied by numerical/application policy and is not inferred from current or historical indicator results.
No universal default H_budget is selected by F-SI26.
Certificate is unavailable when B_inf or H_budget is unavailable/invalid.
candidate_assessment.defensible_meaning: C_h is consumption of an explicitly configured head-domain temporal-indicator budget.
candidate_assessment.linear_scope_implication: Within the exact linear scope where B_inf is a qualified infinity-norm upper bound, C_h<=1 also implies the exact qualified linear endpoint head error is <=H_budget.
candidate_assessment.nonlinear_scope_nonclaim: For nonlinear Richards cases C_h<=1 does not prove exact-solution pressure-head error <=H_budget; it states only that the qualified bounded-stiffness-aware indicator is within the configured budget.
candidate_assessment.reason_selected: Dimensionally exact, monotone, non-empirical, compatible with F-KT09, preserves the original indicator, and keeps the accuracy-budget choice outside the estimator.

candidate_assessment.reason: No authoritative scientific or application requirement supplies a universal cm scale. Deriving one from observed matrices, legacy CritDevH or the F-KT09 <=1 shape would be calibration/semantic overreach.

Pressure-head magnitude is not a stable proxy for constitutive or interface sensitivity. A relative-to-|h| rule can permit increasing absolute deviations in dry states and has no source-bound scale law here. A future application may define a separate explicit mixed absolute/relative budget, but F-SI26 will not manufacture one.

B_M is an M-weighted head norm, not a water-balance residual or direct storage error. M=C*dz is state dependent. Hard mass is independently enforced, and an M-only certificate would not establish head/interface accuracy.

Groundwater coupling head/flux residual targets belong to coupler/application semantics. Directly equating them to a Richards temporal-indicator budget would create a silent coupling dependency and conflate discretization error with interface convergence.

If independent qualification rejects the selected budget-consumption semantics or no application can provide a defensible H_budget, dimensional B_inf remains useful diagnostically without an acceptance certificate.

selected_candidate.valid_domain: B_inf finite and >=0; H_budget finite and >0; F-SI25 indicator available in its qualified operator envelope; continuation provenance valid
selected_candidate.acceptance_surface_for_later_F_KT: candidate semantics are compatible with C_h<=1, but F-SI26 does not activate or qualify F-KT acceptance/retry
selected_candidate.budget_owner: explicit numerical/application policy outside the F-SI25 estimator
selected_candidate.parameter_class: numerical accuracy configuration, not physical soil/crop/boundary parameter
selected_candidate.mass_tolerance_relationship: none; mass remains an independent absolute hard gate
selected_candidate.nonlinear_solver_tolerance_relationship: none; Newton/head convergence tolerance is not the temporal budget
selected_candidate.coupling_residual_relationship: none by default; any application-derived relationship must be separately explicit and qualified

retry_semantics.reason: Existing negative evidence forbids assuming retry halving automatically improves the certificate on an evolving nonlinear trajectory.
retry_semantics.downstream_requirement: Any F-KT production binding must use bounded retry/fallback semantics and independently characterize actual retry behavior rather than relying on monotonicity.

bootstrap_and_discontinuity.forcing_event_topology_discontinuity: previous derivative must not be silently reused; certificate unavailable until a separately qualified right-side continuation/bootstrap is available
bootstrap_and_discontinuity.restart: unrelated or unverifiable history is unavailable/fail closed
